title: Mail Sender
subtitle: Desktop Email Automation Tool
summary: A cross-platform desktop application for sending personalized bulk emails through a structured and reliable workflow.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: Mail Sender is a desktop application created to simplify repetitive email workflows where similar messages need to be personalized and sent to multiple recipients.
The project turns a recurring manual task into a structured workflow covering recipient import, email templates, attachments, validation, preview, and delivery.

responsibilities.title: Responsibilities
items: Design and implement the complete desktop email workflow.
Build SMTP-based email delivery with personalized recipient content and multiple attachments.
Implement recipient import, validation, email preview, and sending-result feedback.
Add automated tests for core mail delivery behavior.
Configure CI/CD and cross-platform application packaging for macOS and Windows.
Design credential handling with secure operating-system storage where supported.

technical_highlights.title: Technical Highlights
paragraphs: The project focuses on turning low-level SMTP functionality into a practical desktop workflow while keeping email preparation, validation, delivery, and credential handling clearly separated.

items.title: Designing a safe bulk-email workflow
items.description: Bulk sending introduces the risk of incorrect recipients, content, or attachments, so validation and preview steps were added before messages are delivered.

items.title: Handling credentials securely
items.description: SMTP authentication needed to remain convenient without treating credentials as ordinary application configuration, requiring platform-aware credential storage and fallback behavior.

items.title: Packaging across platforms
items.description: The application needed to run as a standalone desktop tool on both macOS and Windows while preserving consistent behavior across development and packaged environments.

outcome.title: Outcome
paragraphs: The project evolved from a personal automation need into a packaged desktop application that provides a repeatable workflow for preparing, validating, and sending personalized emails.

lessons_learned.title: Lessons Learned
items: Automation is most useful when the surrounding validation and user workflow are designed together with the core functionality.
Packaging a Python application introduces platform-specific concerns that do not appear during normal development.
Automated testing and CI/CD make small desktop utilities significantly easier to maintain and release.
